en.headline: Weekend primary sales near 180 as second-hand deals thin out
en.dek: Sing Tao put the two-day first-hand tally near 180, led by 147 units at a southwest Kowloon project, while HK01 said ten major estates recorded five sales.
body: First-hand flats took most of the weekend's attention, with reports putting primary sales over Saturday and Sunday near 180, while the ten major housing estates managed only a handful of second-hand deals.

Sing Tao reported on Monday morning that a China Resources Land project in southwest Kowloon, 叡璟II, sold 147 units at its second-round sale on Saturday, for more than HK$1.524 billion. Of those, 129 price-list flats raised more than HK$1.226 billion, at prices from HK$5.655 million to HK$16.403 million. The paper said one buyer spent more than HK$39.53 million on one three-bedroom and three two-bedroom flats.

Other projects moved more slowly. Sing Tao recorded five deals at a Kai Tak harbour project, about HK$36.22 million; four at a Sun Hung Kai project in Yuen Long, more than HK$24.42 million; and four at a Yau Tong project, more than HK$24.15 million. A top-floor flat with a roof at 101 King's Road in North Point sold for HK$55.95 million, about HK$50,000 a square foot on the 1,119-square-foot interior.

On the second-hand side, HK01, citing Centaline, said the ten major estates recorded five deals, down from nine the previous weekend, with seven estates recording none. The paper listed two sales at Metro City and two at City One Shatin.

zh.headline: 周末一手約180宗成交 十大屋苑二手只錄5宗
zh.dek: 《星島》統計周末一手約180宗，西南九龍叡璟II周六次輪售出147伙；《香港01》引述中原指十大屋苑僅5宗。
body: 周末樓市焦點落在一手新盤。報道把周六及周日的一手成交計為約180宗，十大屋苑二手則只有數宗。
《星島》星期一早上報道，華潤置地西南九龍叡璟II周六次輪銷售售出147個單位，總成交金額逾15.24億元。其中129伙價單單位套現逾12.26億元，成交價介乎565.5萬至1640.3萬元。報道指，一名買家斥資逾3953萬元，購入一伙三房及三伙兩房。
其餘項目步伐較慢。《星島》錄得啟德海灣周末5宗、約3622萬元；新鴻基元朗芊御4宗、逾2442萬元；油塘朗譽4宗、逾2415萬元。北角101 KINGS ROAD一伙頂層連天台單位以5595萬元售出，實用面積1119方呎，呎價約5萬元。
二手方面，《香港01》引述中原稱，十大屋苑周末錄得5宗成交，少於上周末的9宗，七個屋苑零成交。報道列出將軍澳新都城2宗、沙田第一城2宗。
